class.name: MultiplayerSnapshotBuffer3D
class.brief_description: Stores and samples delayed 3D transform snapshots for multiple network entities.
class.description: Snapshots are stored independently by entity ID and must be pushed in increasing tick order. Sampling interpolates complete 3D transforms between surrounding snapshots. A snapshot marked as a teleport is not blended with the preceding snapshot. When sampling beyond the newest snapshot, linear velocity extrapolation is capped by [member max_extrapolation_ticks].

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears snapshots for [param entity_id], or all entities when [param entity_id] is negative.

method.name: get_latest_tick
method.description: Returns the newest buffered tick, or [code]-1[/code] when the entity has no snapshots.

method.name: get_snapshot_count
method.description: Returns the number of buffered snapshots for the entity.

method.name: get_tick_delta
method.description: Returns the duration of one snapshot tick in seconds.

method.name: push_transform
method.description: Adds a transform snapshot. Returns [code]false[/code] for a duplicate or stale tick.

method.name: sample_transform
method.description: Samples the entity at a fractional tick. The result contains [code]ok[/code], [code]mode[/code], [code]tick[/code], [code]transform[/code], [code]linear_velocity[/code], and [code]teleport[/code], plus interpolation or extrapolation metadata when applicable.

members.member: Maximum number of ticks to extrapolate beyond an entity's newest snapshot.
Maximum buffered snapshot count per entity.
